[SWS_CRYPT_20002]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The
ara::crypto::x509::X509Provider
shall
store and provide the root
ara::crypto::x509::Certificate
and all needed
CAs
along the
certification path
, together with the reference to the corre-
sponding public and private keys, which are handled by the
ara::crypto::keys::
KeyStorageProvider
. All elements, which are relevant for the
certification
path
, shall be stored with local access either hard-coded into the software or in a per-
sistent and tamper-proof manner. The decision how to store the elements is based
on:
•
Updatability of certificates: When certificates shall be exchangeable or revocable,
then these are stored in a volatile but persistent storage. Fixed certificates, which
stay forever for example, can be stored hard-coded.
•
Use case specific: An application or
Functional Cluster
can have pre-
configured certificates, which are stored along side the configuration, e.g. in
ARXML.
•
Project specific
⌋
